summary: The change does what was asked. athena.toml now pins sccache 0.10.0. In both the change and study capabilities, it routes Rust compilation through that sccache binary (RUSTC_WRAPPER), keeps the cache under {athena_home}/sccache and turns off incremental compilation. The two existing build settings (CARGO_TARGET_DIR and CARGO_TERM_COLOR) are unchanged. The binary path matches where the setup step installs it (paths.rs), and the {athena_home} placeholder is filled in by env.rs. The config.rs tests were rewritten: they still check that the pin is optional and that it rejects extra fields. A new test fails if the binary path's version and the pin's version ever disagree. CHANGELOG and decisions.md record D80, mark D79's deferred step done and say the speedup was not measured. I ran `cargo test --locked`, clippy and fmt myself, and all three were clean. As D80 itself notes, builds will fail until setup has installed sccache 0.10.0. That trade-off is documented, not a defect. The only finding is a nit: an older CHANGELOG entry still says the pin is "absent today".
